spec.name: say-hello
spec.description: 提供 say_hello 工具的最小 DSH 插件
spec.overview: 插件向 DSH Agent 注册一个名为 say_hello 的工具：输入一个必填字符串参数 name，返回固定格式问候语 "Hello, <name>!"。工具无状态、无外部依赖。
goals: 向 DSH Agent 注册 say_hello 工具
工具接受必填参数 name（string）
工具返回字符串 "Hello, <name>!"，name 原样拼接
nonGoals: 不集成任何外部服务或本地应用
不维护状态、不做持久化
不做多语言、模板扩展或 name 的内容校验/转义
userScenarios: 用户在对话中让 Agent 打招呼，Agent 调用 say_hello 工具并展示返回的问候语

tools.name: say_hello
tools.description: 生成问候语：接收名字并返回 "Hello, <name>!"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: 被问候者的名字，原样拼入返回值

dependencies.name: dsh-core 工具注册 API
dependencies.reason: 以官方机制向 Agent 注册工具

constraints: 输出格式固定为 "Hello, <name>!"，<name> 为输入参数原样拼接
name 是必填字符串参数
edgeCases: name 为纯空白：原样保留并拼接
name 含换行或特殊字符：原样拼接，不转义
acceptanceCriteria: 插件能够在全新真实 DSH 运行时中被加载
Agent 可以调用 say_hello，传入任意识别名后返回 "Hello, <name>!"
缺失 name 或 name 非字符串时按 DSH 工具框架的参数校验行为处理

spec.overview: Registers a single local tool named say_hello with no external dependencies. The tool takes a required non-empty string parameter name and returns the plain text greeting `Hello, <name>!`. It is stateless and performs no I/O beyond producing the greeting string.

State or persistence
Configurable behavior

spec.name: say-hello
spec.description: Adds a say_hello tool that greets a user by name.
spec.overview: A minimal DSH plugin that provides a single say_hello tool. The tool takes a name:string parameter and returns the greeting string 'Hello, <name>!'. It demonstrates the canonical structure and flow for generating a DSH plugin.
goals: Provide a say_hello tool callable by the agent.
The tool accepts one required parameter name of type string.
The tool returns the string 'Hello, <name>!' substituting the provided name.
nonGoals: No additional tools or capabilities beyond say_hello.
No persistence, configuration, or external dependencies.
No localization or custom formatting beyond the fixed greeting pattern.
userScenarios: A user asks the agent to greet someone by name; the agent calls say_hello with that name and reports the greeting.
A developer inspects the plugin to learn the minimal required structure of a DSH tool plugin.

tools.name: say_hello
tools.description: Returns the greeting 'Hello, <name>!' for the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name to include in the greeting.

tools.output: A string in the exact form 'Hello, <name>!'.

constraints: The plugin implements only a single tool named say_hello.
The tool must be registered through ctx.on/ctx.effect following repository conventions.
The parameter name is required and of type string; the output format is exactly 'Hello, <name>!'.
The plugin lives under packages/generated/say-hello/ matching the repository workspace glob.
edgeCases: Empty string name still yields 'Hello, !' (no validation added beyond required).
The tool handles any string name without additional processing.
acceptanceCriteria: The plugin builds and passes repository verification gates.
Calling say_hello with name='World' returns 'Hello, World!'.
The tool is registered and appears in the runtime so a fresh agent can invoke it.
